name: Create Daily Classroom Schedule Display Flipchart
description:
An elementary school teacher needs a daily schedule display for their classroom. Create a 2-page flipchart:

Page 1 — Daily Schedule: Title 'Daily Schedule' at the top. Below the title, create at least 5 colored rectangle blocks arranged vertically down the page. Each block must contain both a time and an activity label. Include these five schedule items (you may add more): '8:00 - Morning Meeting', '9:00 - Reading', '10:00 - Math', '11:00 - Science', '12:00 - Lunch'. Each rectangle block should have a distinct fill color (not all the same color).

Page 2 — Homework: Title 'Homework' at the top. Add at least 3 labeled rectangle boxes — one for each subject — listing today's homework assignments. Include homework items for Math, Reading, and one other subject of your choice. Each assignment box should clearly label the subject name.

Login as ga / password123. Save the completed flipchart as /home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/daily_schedule.flipchart
